name: 180-degree headers (crossplane V8)
notes: For the crossplane V8 (engine.layout V8 crossplane): each collector takes four cylinders that fire 180 degrees apart, pairs across the banks (cylinders 1 4 6 7 and 2 3 5 8 by the layout's numbering from 1), so each side's pulses come evenly: the bank collector's burble gone. Measured on made-up pulses: the off-order lines 24 to 27 dB down at each tail. A part build: only spec.exhaust; every other field keeps its default.
